a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if no storm hits in rounds 1 and 2, which is about a 4% chance. Both of us would almost surely end up with nothing. The reserve already holds exactly 4, so I'm taking 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, because a random split would leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. I know this breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
